technical.summary: ACN shows mixed technicals with bullish short-term structure (Hull flip, Supertrend, Ichimoku) but overbought conditions, bearish stochastic cross, and weak long-term trend (below 200-SMA) limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 30 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed small trades from junior members; broad market neutral sentiment with no news data to confirm directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (268) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 30 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for multinational ACN.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, Supertrend bullish, and Ichimoku above cloud provide short-term structural confirmation with price near support (274.32) offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought stochastic cross, price below 200-SMA, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (268), earnings event risk in 30 days, and zero fundamental conviction create a high-risk setup despite technical bounce signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical bounce signals (Hull flip, Supertrend, Ichimoku) offer short-term structure at support, but macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 268) and earnings event risk in 30 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve recession signal combined with VIX crisis levels and 30-day earnings event creates compounding macro and event risk; overbought stochastic cross suggests momentum exhaustion into headwinds.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case despite technical bounce
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 8 other IT holdings in 44-position portfolio creates sector concentration; skip reduces redundant exposure and preserves capital in crisis macro environment.
